title: Order Status — Agent Instruction Diagram
subtitle: How the service agent handles the "Where is my order?" job to be done

topic.name: Order Status & Delivery
topic.classification: Customer asks where an order is, when it will arrive, or wants to change a delivery slot.
topic.scope: Look up orders owned by the verified customer, share status and ETA, rebook delivery. Not in scope: refunds, returns, pricing.

guardrails: Always verify the customer's identity before sharing order details
Never promise a delivery date that the carrier has not confirmed

steps.label: Ask for the order number or the email used at checkout
Summarise status and ETA in plain language
Offer to rebook delivery when the order is delayed
Transfer to a service rep with the conversation summary
